title: 3D type
description: One or two words as real extruded letters with gold sides: they stand up one after the other, catch the light, and the whole word turns to the other side at the cue (@remotion/three: three.js TextGeometry, WebGL). The typeface is Droid Sans Bold, which covers Latin letters, digits and common signs.

source.also: three 0.170 (MIT) TextGeometry + FontLoader; typeface three/examples/fonts/droid/droid_sans_bold.typeface.json (Droid Sans, Apache-2.0, The Android Open Source Project)

props.text: 1-3 words (Latin letters and digits; other scripts are skipped)
props.hi: the word whose faces take the colour (optional)
props.color: that colour, and the back light (gold)
props.sub: small caps line under the word (optional)
props.cues: {"turn": time} when the word swings to its other side
